skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles and methods of public administration in land management.
Analyze land management policies and their impact on land use.
Evaluate land management policies and their effectiveness.
Understand legal frameworks governing land management.
Collaborate effectively in group projects related to land management.
Apply critical thinking to solve land management issues.
Effectively present research findings on land management.
Conduct research on land management policies and practices.

prerequisite_courses: Research Methods in Economics and Society
